dedupe_keys.name: dados dos programados dos elementos de fluxo controlado

description: ONS publishes scheduled quantities for controlled-flow elements used in electricity-system operation. The dictionary identifies the daily programme date, load block, element name and description, terminal type, submarket and load in megawatts. These fields support electricity-dispatch and controlled-interchange studies. They describe scheduled operation, not verified physical flows. The metadata does not establish the duration of every load block or full network connectivity. Coverage is controlled-flow elements and terminals in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
